data.name: Ibhar
data.gender_notes: Ibhar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'b-h-r', meaning 'to be fruitful, to grow'. In Islamic tradition, Ibhar symbolizes prosperity, success, and good fortune. It is a name given to inspire growth and abundance in a child's life. The name Ibhar carries the meaning “Prosperity, Success” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ibhar usually hope their child will grow to embody prosperity, success and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by God's promise of blessings and success in life.
data.etymology: Ibhar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prosperity, Success.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibhar total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
